_readme: Relevance filters applied by scripts/fetch-events.js at ingest time.
Events matching any rule below are EXCLUDED from events.json and the site,
and logged to excluded-events.json (committed on every fetch) so you can
audit false positives. All matching is case-insensitive.
venue_blocklist  — exact venue names to always exclude (non-metro or non-comedy venues).
city_blocklist   — venue_city values to always exclude (outside the Houston metro).
title_blocklist  — keyword/phrase substrings that mark a non-comedy event
artist_blocklist — music acts that appear in comedy venues' Eventbrite feeds;
matched as a substring of the event title.
genre_blocklist  — Ticketmaster genre names to exclude (catches touring
musicals/plays that leak into TM's comedy search).
title_allowlist  — keyword/phrase substrings that PROTECT an event from
artist blocks). Use this to keep comedy-adjacent events
like live podcasts that would otherwise be caught.
